english.note: Use 車龍 when you want to emphasize the long line of vehicles formed by the jam.

examples.english: Before the tunnel, there was already a traffic jam of cars stretching as far as I could see.
examples.traditional: 入隧道前已經排咗成條車龍，望唔到盡頭。
